name: Prepare and validate a CALL-E Goal Run business mapping

parameters.content:
## Prepare a Goal mapping before dialing

Requires @call-e/n8n-nodes-calle >=0.3.0. Select your CALL-E credential on both CALL-E nodes. Choose your published Goal with Published Goal → From List, or set goal_id in Goal Settings. Keep dry_run=true. The first preparation shows input_fields, result_fields, required flags, types, defaults, enums, and RunSpec version.

Map your business row to the returned input names. test_reference is an example input, not a standard field. Review the result mapping too: this sample only treats explicit confirmed=yes as confirmation. Save goal_json as a fixed reviewed_goal_interface in Goal Settings after reviewing it. Do not bind it to the latest Goal output.

Missing/unknown/wrongly typed fields and publication changes keep ready=false and goal_id empty. Change the saved interface only after reviewing the affected input and result mappings. Set dry_run=false and an authorized phone only when ready for a real call.

The API pins the current publication at acceptance; it has no per-run version selector. The final mapping checks the accepted RunSpec and retains the Run ID if publication raced with preparation. Save original input/key for uncertain-create recovery. Timeout does not cancel a run; recover with Get by ID. For durable business-state storage and waiting, use the appointment example.
